messages:
Maya: Quick async sync — OptKit delivery status. Where are we on quant recommendations doc and batching/caching PRs? Top things: quant recs, batching infra e2e, regression alert hooks. Any blockers?
Ethan: Quant doc is in PR #482, awaiting review from @Ravi for the perf assumptions. I left inline comments about model sizes and int8 profiles.
Ravi: I'll review tonight. Main question: do we lock on Llama-2-70B or keep multi-model notes? Prefer multi but callouts for 70B perf.
Maya: Let's keep multi-model but include a recommended baseline (70B fp16 + int8 recs). We need a short table for recommended quant configs.
Jun: Batching infra — test harness passed on dev cluster, but cache eviction bug surfaced under pressure. Repro steps: 
Jun: `./run-load.sh --seq 1024 --concurrency 64`
Jun: Logs: `cache_evict: race at 0x7fff` — working on fix. ETA tomorrow.
Ethan: Good catch. Jun, can you open a small PR that reverts the new eviction heuristic until fix? We can canary it.
Jun: Yep opening now: #494
CI-bot: nightly-ci | quant-recs branch failed on `integration/perf` — tail:
CI-bot: ```
ERROR: Perf regression >5% for 70b_int8 on p3.2xlarge
```
Maya: Noted — possible config mismatch. @Ethan can you look at the model compile flags? Maybe someone changed `--kv-compress`.
Ethan: Looking. Found a compile flag change in #489 — `--kv-compress=true` was added. Rolling back for canary.
Ravi: After I review the doc I can validate the perf tests. Also, who owns the rollout policy for Dedicated? We need an owner to set fallbacks.
Maya: Ownership: Platform team owns rollout policy default; assign @Ravi for optkit defaults and @Jun for infra rollout hooks. Ok?
Ravi: Ack
Jun: Ack
Maya: Action items:
Maya: - @Ravi review quant doc by EOD
Maya: - @Ethan revert compile flag in canary and run perf job
Maya: - @Jun fix eviction bug and PR #494
Maya: - @CI-bot re-run perf after canary
Maya: Ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
Ethan: on it
Ravi: will do
Jun: starting fix now
OpsBot: Reminder: Standup tomorrow 10:00am — optkit mini-demo slot assigned to Maya
Maya: Cool, I'll prepare a 5-min demo and slides.
